name: pixel-office
description: Shows your Claude Code sessions as little people in a self-hosted pixel-art office. Sends hook events to your pixel-office server; costs the model zero tokens.

server_url.title: pixel-office server URL
server_url.description: Where your pixel-office server runs, e.g. https://office.example.com or http://127.0.0.1:4790

token.title: Ingest token
token.description: The server's ingest token (run `pixel-office token` on the server)
